verdict.rationale: The first-party docs say the firewall is enabled by default. All incoming traffic is blocked except port 22 (SSH) and port 53317 (LocalSend), so a switcher gets protection with no manual setup. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the default firewall is active after install, and documentation of which firewall tool is used and how to change the rules (only a single line in the docs covers it).
